result.title: Grounding with Confidence: Controllable Generative Video Temporal Grounding
result.summary: Video temporal grounding supports applications such as video search, content review, and automated editing by localizing events described in natural language. Yet existing generative models typically output timestamps without explicit interval-level confidence scores to guide candidate selection. We separate candidate generation from acceptance by scoring individual intervals within the original decoding pass. A lightweight confidence head reads pooled decoder states, providing an explicit score trained for interval selection. Offline verifier scores supervise the head on fixed candidate sequences, and temporal-overlap labels adapt it to current rollouts during reinforcement learning. GT-anchored candidate-pool supervision and set-level optimization train the generator. The resulting scores support ranking, threshold-based selection, and rejection without invoking an external verifier at inference. On a fixed OMTG-Bench candidate pool, confidence raises query-macro Recall@0.5 from 9.95% to 14.42% over generation order at a 10% global return budget, and from 26.48% to 31.12% at a 25% budget. The continuous scores let downstream applications adjust return budgets or acceptance thresholds to match their precision-recall preferences, without regenerating candidate intervals.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究生成式视频时间定位：在原始解码过程中用轻量置信度头读取池化的解码器状态，为每个候选时间区间输出显式置信分，并借助离线验证器分数与强化学习中的时序重叠标签来训练该头，从而把候选生成与候选接受分离，支持排序、阈值筛选和拒绝。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心概念是“用置信度显式刻画内部状态的候选可信度并据此决定接受/拒绝”，可能为 LVR 中基于状态证据的 STOP 决策与动态计算分配提供参考，但论文场景为视频时间定位，与 latent 视觉推理的直接联系需核查。
